verdict.summary: Round 2 remains correct and complete. The classifier now consumes the ownership map using the same first-match semantics as closure selection, while explicitly preventing full-run triggers and crates/** paths from being made inert. Missing, unreadable, malformed, or entry-invalid map data degrades conservatively to the pre-change engine classification. The three workflow consumers recognize the new map-safe token consistently, and the focused tests cover the real classifier/select and classify-only paths, protected ZK anchors, trigger/crate exclusions, mixed-class composition, malformed inputs, default and explicit map discovery, workflow token drift, and a mutation check. No correctness, soundness, security, test-vacuity, or prompt-injection issue is present in the supplied diff.
